## 4. Access intensity, the knee, and Little's Law

**Single core (independent random chains, 512 MiB):** idle latency 156.6 ns, peak 7.78 GB/s. Little's Law, L = λ·W: in-flight lines = 7.78 GB/s / 64 B x 156.6 ns = **19.0**, an estimate of the core's outstanding-miss limit (L1 fill buffers / superqueue). Latency per hop exceeds 1.25x idle at **8 chains**.
